csrpmon.species.buglin.name: Buglin
csrpmon.species.buglin.desc: A tiny parasitic grub that crawls through infected soil.
csrpmon.species.rupter.name: Rupter
csrpmon.species.rupter.desc: Its swollen body detonates in a shower of burning ichor when threatened.
csrpmon.species.gnat.name: Gnat
csrpmon.species.gnat.desc: A buzzing swarmer that rides the parasitic fog.
csrpmon.species.lice.name: Lice
csrpmon.species.lice.desc: It burrows into flesh and drinks whatever the hive needs.
csrpmon.species.mangler.name: Mangler
csrpmon.species.mangler.desc: Bladed forelimbs tear through armour like wet parchment.
csrpmon.species.worker.name: Worker
csrpmon.species.worker.desc: The hive's builder. It never stops digging.
csrpmon.species.heed.name: Heed
csrpmon.species.heed.desc: Its unblinking gaze maps every mind within a hundred paces.
csrpmon.species.thrall.name: Thrall
csrpmon.species.thrall.desc: A human shape hollowed out and refilled with parasite muscle.
csrpmon.species.host.name: Host
csrpmon.species.host.desc: A walking incubator, its hide slick with hatching brood.
csrpmon.species.hostii.name: Host II
csrpmon.species.hostii.desc: The brood has fully consumed it. What answers to the name is the hive itself.
csrpmon.species.dredge.name: Dredge
csrpmon.species.dredge.desc: Drills through bedrock leaving tunnels of wet red clay.
csrpmon.species.lightcarrier.name: Light Carrier
csrpmon.species.lightcarrier.desc: Fast enough to outrun an arrow, and it knows it.
csrpmon.species.heavycarrier.name: Heavy Carrier
csrpmon.species.heavycarrier.desc: Plated in assimilated iron, it ferries the hive's heaviest broods.
csrpmon.species.primitivevermin.name: Primitive Vermin
csrpmon.species.primitivevermin.desc: The first successful parasite body plan, and still the most common.
csrpmon.species.primitivelongarms.name: Primitive Longarms
csrpmon.species.primitivelongarms.desc: Those arms are longer than they look. They are always longer.
csrpmon.species.primitivesummoner.name: Primitive Summoner
csrpmon.species.primitivesummoner.desc: It does not fight alone. It never had to.
csrpmon.species.primitiveviscera.name: Primitive Viscera
csrpmon.species.primitiveviscera.desc: A sack of organs that walks without needing a body around it.
csrpmon.species.marauder.name: Marauder
csrpmon.species.marauder.desc: Runs down anything that flees. That is the whole of its purpose.
csrpmon.species.architect.name: Architect
csrpmon.species.architect.desc: It reshapes the hive with the calm patience of a thing that has no enemies.
csrpmon.species.crux.name: Crux
csrpmon.species.crux.desc: A living nexus. Every parasite within a mile knows where it is.
csrpmon.species.draconite.name: Draconite
csrpmon.species.draconite.desc: Where the Crux fed long enough, the ground grows teeth of black crystal.
csrpmon.species.kirin.name: Kirin
csrpmon.species.kirin.desc: The apex of the hive. Storms follow it; it does not appear to notice.
csrpmon.species.ancientdreadnaut.name: Ancient Dreadnaut
csrpmon.species.ancientdreadnaut.desc: A siege engine grown from the corpse of something that used to be a city.
csrpmon.species.ancientoverlord.name: Ancient Overlord
csrpmon.species.ancientoverlord.desc: It gives orders and the world rearranges itself to obey.
csrpmon.message.already_in_battle: You are already in a battle.
csrpmon.mod.name: CSRPmon - Parasite Battles
csrpmon.species.primitox.name: Primitox
csrpmon.species.primitox.desc: Both arms are overgrown and barbed, opening a victim up and seeding it with paralysing venom in the same motion.
csrpmon.species.beckonbloom.name: Beckon Bloom
csrpmon.species.beckonbloom.desc: A rooted parasite that unfurls into a black flower around a single staring core.
csrpmon.species.beckonqueen.name: Beckon Queen
csrpmon.species.beckonqueen.desc: It calls parasites out of the ground and feeds them the field.
csrpmon.species.worldnode.name: World Node
csrpmon.species.worldnode.desc: The hive has no shape left that is not this thing.
cobblemon.ability.swiftsymbiosis.desc: Physical moves are 20% stronger while faster than the target, and contact has a 30% chance to poison.
cobblemon.ability.parasiticinstinct.desc: Damaging a target has a 30% chance to seed it, draining its health each turn.
cobblemon.ability.colonyinfection.desc: While another Bug type is on the field, Speed is raised by 50%.
cobblemon.ability.hiveswarm.desc: Moves deal 30% more damage to a seeded target.
cobblemon.ability.adaptivemutation.desc: Knocking out a Pokemon raises one random stat by one stage.
Below 30% HP, Attack and Speed are both raised by 50%.
cobblemon.ability.parasiticnest.desc: The nest damages every opponent for 1/16 of their maximum HP at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.move.rendingclaws.desc: Hits 2 to 5 times. Against a poisoned target it always hits 5 times and heals the user for 20% of the damage dealt.
cobblemon.move.parasiticbite.desc: The user recovers a third of the damage it deals.
cobblemon.move.hivebite.desc: Hits 2 to 3 times, and deals 50% more damage to a target suffering a status condition.
cobblemon.move.devourevolution.desc: If this knocks out the target, the user gains one stage in a random stat.
cobblemon.move.nestsummon.desc: Raises the user Special Attack and Special Defence by one stage each.
cobblemon.ability.primitivewildness.desc: Below half HP, Speed is raised by 50% and sleep and paralysis cannot be inflicted.
